intro: The HCIA Lab at SVNIT Surat welcomes motivated students. Send a short CV, a one-paragraph statement of interest naming the topic below, and any code/GitHub links.

openings.title: PhD positions
topics: EEG microstates and spatiotemporal brain dynamics of emotion
Reinforcement learning for empathetic and reasoning LLMs
Computational models of emotion and contemplative practice
requirements: M.Tech./M.Sc. (or B.Tech. with strong record) in CS, AI, EE, Cognitive Science or a related field
Strong Python; experience with PyTorch and/or MNE/EEGLAB is a plus
Apply through the SVNIT PhD admission process and email the PI beforehand

openings.title: Summer research internship
topics: Building web demos for affective sensing (webcam rPPG, expression analysis)
requirements: Able to commit at least 8 weeks

openings.title: Winter research internship
topics: RL environments and agents (gridworld to LLM post-training)
requirements: Able to commit at least 4 weeks
